content.text: You are a weather assistant. You have access to a get_weather tool. You must call the get_weather tool for any weather question and never guess weather data. After receiving the tool result, provide a concise summary of the weather.

messages.content: I'm planning a trip. What is the current weather in Tokyo, Japan? Based on the weather conditions, should I pack an umbrella or sunscreen? Use the get_weather tool to check before answering.
Weather in Tokyo, Japan: 72F (22C), sunny with light clouds, humidity 45%, wind 8 mph NW

function.description: Get the current weather for a city. Must be called for weather questions.
